examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}{経費|けいひ}を{会社|かいしゃ}に{請求|せいきゅう}した。
examples.english: I claimed business trip expenses from the company.

examples.japanese: {経費|けいひ}を{削減|さくげん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
これは{経費|けいひ}で{落|お}とせる。
examples.english: This can be written off as a business expense.

notes:
{経費|けいひ} refers to business or operational expenses, often tax-deductible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経費|けいひ}を{使|つか}う (to use expenses)
- {経費|けいひ}を{請求|せいきゅう}する (to claim expenses)
- {経費|けいひ}で{落|お}とす (to write off as expense)
- {経費|けいひ}{削減|さくげん} (expense reduction)
- {経費|けいひ}{精算|せいさん} (expense settlement/reimbursement)

TYPES OF BUSINESS EXPENSES:
- {交通費|こうつうひ} (transportation costs)
- {通信費|つうしんひ} (communication costs)
- {接待費|せったいひ} (entertainment expenses)
- {消耗品費|しょうもうひんひ} (consumable costs)
- {人件費|じんけんひ} (personnel costs)

CONTRAST:
- {費用|ひよう}: General costs/fees
- {経費|けいひ}: Business operating expenses specifically
